items.title: Charles McPherson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 9, 2024 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: And it was basically inspired by my involvement with Paul Chambers, Barry Harris, Billy Higgins, and Lonnie Hillyer, a trumpet player, and myself. We had a gig

ctx.x: Was this a conscious decision to —

Yeah. It was. Yeah. Because most of the time you’re going to get the trumpet or the saxophone or the horns play first. So just for the sake of variation and, you know, to add a different flavor, you know I like to have the bass or piano player play first, not only in clubs but on records as well. And it was written to be their feature you know. It was written to be their feature. And it was basically inspired by my involvement with Paul Chambers, Barry Harris, Billy Higgins, and Lonnie Hillyer, a trumpet player,…
Indeed. And I’m picturing you, were you sitting at the piano laboriously writing out this [scats]-type line?
